Google restricted FAQ rich results to government and health sites in August 2023 and retired them entirely on 7 May 2026, so the markup would produce nothing. en.title: Chrono Mock FAQ - questions about faking dates on Windows
en.description: Does it change the system clock? Does it need admin rights? Will it work with my app, with .NET, Java or Electron? Short answers, including what it will not do.
